**DEWALT (NYSE: SWK)** and August Robotics launched the world's first downward drilling, fleet-capable robot to speed concrete drilling for data center construction. In an ongoing pilot with a leading hyperscaler, the robot drilled >90,000 holes with **99.97% accuracy**, operated up to **10x faster** than traditional methods, and delivered **80 weeks** of schedule savings across 10 projects. The robot will be demoed at World of Concrete Jan 20–22, 2026.
